note: Starter recipes: everyday family dinners. Each links to the full recipe on Taste of Home; the ingredient lists and short steps here are written in our own words.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger Pasta
directions: Brown the beef with the onion and drain.
Add macaroni, tomatoes, broth, ketchup and mustard; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer about 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the cheese until melted.

recipes.name: Beef Enchiladas
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown beef with onion, garlic and cumin; drain.
Stir the refried beans and half the enchilada sauce into the beef.
Fill and roll the tortillas; set seam-side down in a 9x13 dish.
Pour on remaining sauce, top with cheese and bake 20–25 minutes.

recipes.name: Classic Lasagna
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil noodles until just tender.
Brown beef and sausage; drain and stir in marinara, crushed tomatoes and seasoning. Simmer 10 minutes.
Mix ricotta, egg and half the parmesan.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta and mozzarella in a 9x13 three times, ending with sauce and cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes; uncover and bake 20 more. Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Hamburger Stew
directions: Brown beef with onion in a large pot; drain.
Add carrots, celery, potatoes, tomatoes, broth and thyme.
Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 30 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Pizza Pasta Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and boil the rotini.
Brown beef with onion; drain and stir in pizza sauce and seasoning.
Mix in the pasta and spread in a 9x13 dish.
Top with mozzarella and pepperoni; bake 25 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.name: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, milk, onion, nutmeg and salt; roll into 1-inch balls.
Brown meatballs in a skillet in batches; set aside.
Melt butter in the pan, whisk in flour, then broth; simmer until thick.
Stir in sour cream, return meatballs and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over cooked egg noodles.

recipes.name: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Brown beef with onion; drain and stir in soup and green beans.
Spread in a 9x13 dish and top with cheese.
Arrange tater tots on top and bake 35–40 minutes until crisp.

recipes.name: Hamburger Steaks with Mushroom Gravy
directions: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, worcestershire, salt and pepper; shape into 4 oval patties.
Brown patties in a skillet about 4 minutes per side; remove.
Cook mushrooms and onion in the drippings until soft; stir in flour.
Whisk in broth, return patties and simmer 10 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Unstuffed Pepper Skillet
directions: Brown beef with onion, peppers and garlic; drain.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce, rice and broth.
Bring to a boil, cover and simmer 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Sprinkle with cheese, cover until melted.

recipes.name: Walking Tacos
directions: Brown the beef, drain, and stir in taco seasoning with 2/3 cup water; simmer 5 minutes.
Crush the chips lightly in their bags and cut the bags open along the side.
Spoon in beef and top with cheese, lettuce, salsa and sour cream. Eat with a fork right from the bag.

recipes.name: Smothered Burritos
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Brown beef and add taco seasoning with a little water.
Spread beans on tortillas, add beef and roll up; place in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over the burritos and cover with cheese.
Bake 15–20 minutes until bubbly; top with sour cream.

recipes.name: Taco Stuffed Shells
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and boil the shells until just tender.
Brown beef, add taco seasoning and water, then stir in cream cheese until melted.
Spread salsa in a baking dish, fill the shells with beef and set them in the dish.
Pour taco sauce over, cover and bake 25 minutes; add cheese and bake 10 more.

recipes.name: Salisbury Steak
directions: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg and worcestershire; form 4 patties.
Sear patties until browned on both sides; set aside.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the pan, stir in flour, then broth and ketchup.
Return patties, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Good with mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Spanish Rice with Ground Beef
directions: Brown beef with onion and pepper; drain.
Stir in rice and spices and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and broth; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 20–25 minutes until the rice is tender.

recipes.name: Taco Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown beef and add taco seasoning; stir in salsa and mayonnaise.
Layer half the chips, half the beef and half the cheese in a baking dish; repeat.
Bake 20 minutes.
Top with lettuce and tomato to serve.

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Brown beef with pepper, onion and mushrooms; drain and stir in worcestershire.
Spread in a baking dish and cover with provolone.
Lay crescent dough over the top and bake 15–18 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Chili Mac
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and boil the macaroni.
Brown beef with onion; drain and add beans, tomatoes, tomato sauce and chili powder.
Stir in the macaroni and spread in a baking dish.
Top with cheese and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Bacon Cheeseburger Tater Tot Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°F.
Brown beef with onion; drain and stir in soup.
Spread in a 9x13, sprinkle with bacon and cheese, then cover with tater tots.
Bake 45 minutes. Top with chopped pickles if you like.

recipes.name: Cornbread Taco Bake
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Brown beef, drain, and stir in taco seasoning, corn, tomato sauce and 1/2 cup water.
Spread in a baking dish.
Mix cornbread batter with egg and milk; spread over the beef.
Bake 20 minutes, top with cheese and bake 3 more.

recipes.name: Beef and Biscuit Bake
directions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Brown beef with onion; drain and stir in beans, tomato sauce and chili powder. Simmer 5 minutes.
Pour into a baking dish and sprinkle with cheese.
Arrange biscuits on top and bake 15–18 minutes until the biscuits are golden.

recipes.name: Mozzarella Baked Spaghetti
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and cook spaghetti.
Whisk eggs, milk and parmesan; toss with the spaghetti and press into a greased 9x13.
Brown beef with onion, drain, add marinara and spread over the pasta.
Top with mozzarella and bake 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mexican Pasta Bake
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and boil the penne.
Brown beef and add taco seasoning; stir in salsa, beans and corn.
Mix with the pasta and half the cheese; spread in a baking dish.
Top with remaining cheese and bake 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Cabbage Roll Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown beef with onion; drain.
Stir in uncooked rice, tomato sauce, tomatoes and broth.
Layer half the cabbage, half the beef mixture, then repeat in a 9x13.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 hour; top with cheese and bake 10 minutes uncovered.

recipes.name: Asian Beef and Noodles
directions: Brown beef with garlic and ginger; drain.
Cook ramen noodles 2 minutes (skip the flavor packets) and drain.
Add vegetables, soy and hoisin to the beef; cook until hot.
Toss in the noodles and top with green onions.

recipes.name: Beef Stuffed Shells
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and boil shells until just tender.
Brown beef and drain; mix with ricotta, egg, half the mozzarella and the parmesan.
Spread half the marinara in a 9x13, stuff the shells and arrange on top.
Cover with remaining sauce and mozzarella; bake 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Beefy Tortellini Skillet
directions: Brown beef in a large skillet; drain.
Add marinara, broth and seasoning; bring to a simmer.
Stir in tortellini, cover and cook 6–8 minutes until tender.
Top with mozzarella and cover until melted.

recipes.name: Mini Meatloaf Sheet-Pan Dinner
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with oil and roast 10 minutes.
Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, milk, salt and pepper; shape 4 small loaves.
Add loaves and green beans to the pan; mix ketchup and brown sugar and brush over the loaves.
Roast 25 minutes until the meatloaves reach 160°F.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger Soup
directions: Brown beef with onion; drain and set aside.
Simmer carrots, celery and potatoes in broth until tender, about 15 minutes.
In another pan melt butter, stir in flour, then whisk in milk until thick.
Add the sauce, beef and cheese to the pot and stir until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Stuffed Pepper Soup
directions: Brown beef with onion and peppers; drain.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth and seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the rice and heat through.

recipes.name: Taco Soup
directions: Brown beef with onion; drain.
Stir in both seasoning packets, then everything else.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with chips, cheese and sour cream.

ingredients.raw: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles

recipes.name: Beef Burritos
directions: Brown beef, drain and add taco seasoning with a little water.
Warm the refried beans.
Fill tortillas with beans, rice, beef, cheese and salsa; fold into burritos.
Toast seam-side down in a dry skillet until golden.

recipes.name: Patty Melts
directions: Cook onion in 1 tablespoon butter over medium-low until golden, about 15 minutes.
Shape beef into 4 thin oval patties, season and cook until done.
Build sandwiches: bread, dressing, cheese, patty, onions, cheese, bread.
Butter the outsides and grill in a skillet until crisp and melted.

recipes.name: Chopped Cheese
directions: Cook beef and onion on a hot griddle, chopping the meat into small pieces as it browns.
Lay cheese over the beef, let it melt, then chop it all together.
Toast the rolls and spread with mayonnaise and ketchup.
Pile in the beef with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Taco Pasta
directions: Brown beef on Sauté in the pressure cooker; drain and stir in seasoning.
Add broth, salsa and pasta without stirring the pasta under.
Pressure cook on high 4 minutes, then quick release.
Stir in beans and cheese until melted.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Roast Beef and Gravy
directions: Put potatoes and carrots in the slow cooker and set the roast on top.
Mix soup, onion soup mix and broth; pour over the roast.
Cook on low 8 hours until fork-tender.
Slice or shred the beef and spoon the gravy over everything.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Cube Steak
directions: Dredge steaks in seasoned flour and brown quickly in oil.
Layer onion and steaks in the slow cooker.
Whisk gravy mix, soup and water; pour over.
Cook on low 6–8 hours. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Green Chile Beef Burritos
directions: Rub roast with taco seasoning and set in the slow cooker on the onion.
Add chiles and broth; cook on low 8 hours.
Shred the beef in its juices.
Roll into tortillas with cheese.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Beef Carnitas
directions: Season beef with cumin, salt and pepper and put in the slow cooker.
Add chipotles, onion, garlic, orange juice and broth.
Cook on low 8 hours, then shred.
Crisp the shredded beef in a hot skillet and serve in warm tortillas with cilantro.

ingredients.raw: 3 lb beef chuck roast, cut in chunks

recipes.name: Steak Fajitas
directions: Rub steak with chili powder, cumin, salt and lime juice.
Sear in a hot skillet 4–5 minutes per side; rest and slice thinly against the grain.
Cook peppers and onion in the same pan until charred and soft.
Serve in warm tortillas with avocado.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Beef Tips
directions: Put beef, mushrooms, onion, broth and worcestershire in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 7–8 hours.
Stir cornstarch into 3 tablespoons water, add to the pot and cook on high 15 minutes to thicken.
Serve over egg noodles or rice.

recipes.name: French Dip Sandwiches
directions: Put roast in the slow cooker with soup mix, broth and worcestershire.
Cook on low 8 hours, then shred the beef.
Fill rolls with beef and provolone; toast under the broiler until melted.
Serve with the cooking juices for dipping.

recipes.name: Hungarian Goulash
directions: Brown the beef in batches; set aside.
Cook onions until soft, then stir in paprika and garlic for a minute.
Return beef with tomatoes, broth and pepper; simmer covered 1 1/2 hours (or slow-cook on low 8 hours).
Stir in sour cream off the heat and serve over noodles.

recipes.name: Corned Beef and Cabbage
directions: Put potatoes, carrots and onion in the slow cooker; set the brisket on top with its spices.
Add water and cook on low 8 hours.
Add cabbage wedges for the last 2 hours.
Slice the beef thinly against the grain.

ingredients.item: corned beef brisket with spice packet
ingredients.raw: 3 lb corned beef brisket with spice packet
1 head green cabbage, cut in wedges

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Short Ribs
directions: Season ribs and brown on all sides in a hot skillet.
Put onion and garlic in the slow cooker and add the ribs.
Mix broth, bbq sauce, brown sugar and worcestershire; pour over.
Cook on low 8 hours. Skim fat from the sauce and spoon over the ribs.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Korean Beef
directions: Put beef in the slow cooker.
Whisk soy, brown sugar, broth, garlic, ginger and sesame oil; pour over.
Cook on low 7–8 hours until tender.
Serve over rice with green onions.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Beef Stew
directions: Toss beef with flour, salt and pepper.
Put vegetables in the slow cooker and beef on top.
Whisk broth, tomato paste and thyme; pour over.
Cook on low 8–9 hours until the beef is tender.

recipes.name: Skirt Steak Tacos
directions: Marinate steak in lime juice, garlic, cumin and salt for 30 minutes.
Grill steak and onion rings over high heat, 3–4 minutes per side for the steak.
Rest, then slice steak thinly and chop the onion.
Serve in warm tortillas with cilantro and salsa verde.

ingredients.raw: 1 red onion, cut in thick rings

recipes.name: Italian Beef Sandwiches
directions: Put roast in the slow cooker with the dressing mix, broth and pepperoncini with their juice.
Cook on low 8 hours, then shred.
Pile beef and peppers on rolls with provolone.
Spoon a little juice over the top.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Orange Beef
directions: Put beef, orange juice, soy, brown sugar, garlic and ginger in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 5–6 hours.
Stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water and the broccoli; cook on high 20 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken and Orzo Skillet
directions: Brown chicken with garlic and seasoning in a large skillet.
Add orzo, tomatoes and broth; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 12–15 minutes until the orzo is tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted and top with feta.

recipes.name: Salsa Chicken Skillet
directions: Brown chicken with cumin, salt and pepper.
Stir in salsa, beans and corn; simmer 10 minutes.
Top with cheese and cover until melted.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Cheesy Onion Chicken Skillet
directions: Season chicken with garlic powder, salt and pepper and brown in oil.
Add onion, pepper and mushrooms; cook until tender.
Sprinkle with cheese, cover and cook until melted.

recipes.name: Chicken Sweet Potato Skillet
directions: Brown chicken with paprika in oil; set aside.
Cook sweet potatoes and onion 5 minutes, add broth, cover and simmer 10 minutes until tender.
Return chicken, stir in spinach and cook until wilted.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Chili
directions: Brown chicken with onion and celery.
Add wing sauce, tomatoes, beans and broth.
Simmer 25 minutes.
Top with blue cheese or ranch.

recipes.name: Chicken a la King
directions: Melt butter and cook mushrooms until browned.
Stir in flour, then whisk in broth and milk; simmer until thick.
Add chicken, peas and pimientos and heat through.
Spoon over pastry shells, biscuits or toast.

recipes.name: Chicken Lo Mein
directions: Cook noodles and drain.
Stir-fry chicken in a hot pan until cooked; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables and garlic 3–4 minutes.
Add noodles, chicken, soy, oyster sauce and sesame oil; toss until coated.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Chicken Stew
directions: Put vegetables in the slow cooker and chicken on top.
Add broth and thyme; cook on low 7 hours.
Shred chicken in the pot.
Stir in cornstarch mixed with water and cook on high 20 minutes to thicken.

recipes.name: Chicken Provolone
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Season chicken and sear in oil 3 minutes per side.
Move to a baking dish; top each with basil, prosciutto and provolone.
Bake 12–15 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.

recipes.name: Pizza Chicken Roll-Ups
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Pound chicken thin.
Layer pepperoni and mozzarella on each, roll up and secure with toothpicks.
Roll in breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan; bake 30 minutes.
Serve with warm pizza sauce. Remove toothpicks first.

recipes.name: Honey Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Stir-fry chicken and garlic in oil until cooked.
Add vegetables and cook until crisp-tender.
Whisk honey, soy, cornstarch and 1/4 cup water; pour in and cook until glossy.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Salsa Verde Chicken Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix chicken, beans, half the salsa verde and the sour cream.
Layer tortillas, chicken mixture and cheese in a baking dish; repeat.
Pour remaining salsa over and top with cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.name: Easy Mediterranean Chicken
directions: Season chicken with oregano, salt and pepper; brown in oil.
Add garlic, tomatoes, olives and artichokes around the chicken.
Cover and simmer 12–15 minutes until cooked through.
Top with feta. Good with rice or orzo.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Thighs and Noodles
directions: Put chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk soup, cream cheese, dressing mix and broth; pour over.
Cook on low 6 hours, then shred the chicken in the sauce.
Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.name: One-Pan Chicken Curry and Rice
directions: Brown chicken and onion in oil.
Stir in curry powder and rice for a minute.
Add coconut milk and broth; cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Stir in peas and let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Skillet Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Season chicken with oregano, salt and pepper.
Sear chicken skin-side down in an oven-safe skillet until golden; flip.
Tuck potatoes, garlic and lemon around it and roast 25 minutes.
Add green beans and roast 10 more minutes.

recipes.name: Cashew Chicken
directions: Toss chicken with cornstarch and stir-fry until browned.
Add pepper and ginger; cook 2 minutes.
Stir in soy, hoisin and 1/4 cup water until glossy.
Add cashews and green onions; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Smothered Chicken
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble and keep the drippings.
Season chicken with garlic powder and cook in the drippings until done.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the pan until soft.
Top chicken with onions, mushrooms, bacon and cheese; cover until melted.

recipes.name: Chicken Penne Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil penne, adding broccoli for the last 2 minutes.
Drain and mix with chicken and alfredo sauce.
Spread in a baking dish and top with both cheeses.
Bake 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Mix chicken, cream cheese, half the sour cream and the chiles.
Fill and roll tortillas; place in a 9x13.
Mix soup with remaining sour cream and spread over the top.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Lime Chicken Tacos
directions: Put chicken in the slow cooker with chili powder, lime juice, salsa and broth.
Cook on low 6 hours.
Shred and stir back into the juices.
Serve in tortillas with lettuce and cilantro.

recipes.name: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and cook spaghetti.
Soften onion, then stir in soup, tomatoes, Velveeta and broth until melted.
Mix in chicken and spaghetti; spread in a 9x13.
Top with cheddar and bake 25 minutes.

ingredients.raw: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles

recipes.name: Chicken Tater Tot Bake
directions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Mix chicken, soup, sour cream, vegetables and half the cheese; spread in a 9x13.
Top with tater tots and bake 35 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining cheese and bake 5 more.

recipes.name: Air-Fryer Southern-Style Chicken
directions: Soak chicken in buttermilk for at least 1 hour.
Mix flour with paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and salt; dredge chicken.
Spray with oil and air-fry at 375°F for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until 175°F inside.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Sheet-Pan Chicken
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Whisk oil, garlic, lemon juice and zest, oregano and salt.
Toss chicken and potatoes with most of the mixture and roast 25 minutes.
Add asparagus tossed in the rest; roast 10–12 more minutes.

recipes.name: Hoisin Sriracha Sheet-Pan Chicken
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Mix hoisin, sriracha and soy; toss half with the chicken.
Roast chicken 15 minutes.
Add broccoli and pepper tossed in oil; brush chicken with remaining sauce and roast 15 more.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken and Veggies
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes and onion with oil and half the seasoning.
Set chicken on top, season with the rest, and roast 35–40 minutes.
Move chicken to a plate and toss spinach in the hot pan until wilted.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Tandoori Chicken
directions: Mix yogurt, spices, garlic and lemon juice; coat the chicken and chill 30 minutes or more.
Heat oven to 425°F. Toss cauliflower with oil and salt.
Spread chicken and cauliflower on a sheet pan and roast 25–30 minutes.
Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Chicken Veggie Foil Packets
directions: Heat oven to 400°F or a grill to medium.
Put a chicken breast and a pile of vegetables on each sheet of foil.
Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle parmesan and seal the packets.
Bake or grill 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.

recipes.name: Balsamic Chicken Thighs with Root Vegetables
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss vegetables with half the oil, thyme and salt on a sheet pan.
Rub chicken with remaining oil and half the balsamic; set on the vegetables.
Roast 35–40 minutes, then drizzle with the rest of the balsamic.

recipes.name: Black Bean Chicken and Rice
directions: Season chicken with chili powder and cumin; brown in a skillet.
Add beans, salsa and corn; simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Tex-Mex Chicken Strips
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix crushed chips with spices.
Dip tenders in beaten egg, then press into the chip mixture.
Bake on a rack 15–18 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Serve with salsa and sour cream for dipping.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Thai Chicken Thighs
directions: Whisk coconut milk, peanut butter, soy, brown sugar and curry paste in the slow cooker.
Add chicken and cook on low 6 hours.
Stir in lime juice.
Serve over rice with chopped peanuts.

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken Tacos
directions: Slow-cook chicken with 1 cup bbq sauce and the broth on low 6 hours.
Shred and stir in the remaining sauce.
Toss coleslaw mix with ranch.
Fill tortillas with chicken, slaw and red onion.

recipes.name: Orange Chicken
directions: Dip chicken in beaten egg, then toss in cornstarch.
Fry in oil in batches until golden and cooked; drain.
Simmer orange juice, sugar, soy, vinegar and 1 teaspoon cornstarch until thick.
Toss chicken in the sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
directions: Brown chicken in a large skillet.
Add peppers and pineapple chunks; cook 3 minutes.
Whisk pineapple juice, ketchup, vinegar, brown sugar and cornstarch; pour in and simmer until thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Whole Chicken
directions: Put onion slices in the slow cooker.
Rub chicken with spices and salt; tuck lemon halves inside.
Set chicken on the onions and cook on low 6–7 hours until 165°F in the thigh.
Broil a few minutes for crisper skin if you like.

recipes.name: Creamy Italian Chicken
directions: Put chicken in the slow cooker and sprinkle with dressing mix.
Whisk cream cheese, soup and broth; pour over.
Cook on low 6 hours, then shred.
Serve over pasta or rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Brown chicken in a Dutch oven; set aside.
Cook onion, pepper, mushrooms and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes, broth and seasoning; return chicken and simmer covered 30 minutes.
Serve over spaghetti.

recipes.name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Pound chicken thin.
Top each with ham and Swiss, roll up and secure with toothpicks.
Dip in beaten egg, then in panko mixed with parmesan; drizzle with butter.
Bake 25–30 minutes until 165°F. Remove toothpicks before serving.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Chicken Ropa Vieja
directions: Put peppers, onion and garlic in the slow cooker with the chicken on top.
Mix tomato sauce and cumin; pour over.
Cook on low 6 hours, then shred the chicken.
Stir in olives and serve over rice with black beans.

recipes.name: Mongolian Chicken
directions: Toss chicken in cornstarch and fry in oil until crisp; remove.
Cook garlic and ginger 30 seconds, then add soy, brown sugar and 1/4 cup water; simmer until syrupy.
Return chicken and green onions; toss to coat.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Black Pepper Chicken
directions: Toss chicken with cornstarch and stir-fry until browned.
Add onion, pepper and celery; cook 3 minutes.
Stir in soy, oyster sauce, black pepper and a splash of water until glossy.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken with Garlic Sauce
directions: Stir-fry chicken until cooked; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli and zucchini with the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add soy, vinegar, honey and cornstarch mixed with 1/3 cup water; cook until thick.
Return chicken and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Asian Glazed Chicken Thighs
directions: Brown chicken in a skillet on both sides.
Mix soy, honey, vinegar, garlic and ginger; pour over the chicken.
Simmer, turning, until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Wild Rice Soup
directions: Melt butter and soften carrots, celery and onion.
Stir in flour, then broth; add the rice mix and its seasoning.
Simmer 25 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir in chicken and half-and-half and heat through.

ingredients.raw: 1 box long-grain and wild rice mix

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie Soup
directions: Bake biscuits according to the package.
Melt butter and soften onion; stir in flour, then broth and milk.
Add potatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Add chicken and vegetables, heat through and serve with a biscuit on top.

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Soak chicken in buttermilk at least 30 minutes.
Dredge in flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Fry in 1 inch of 350°F oil about 5 minutes per side until 175°F.
Serve on toasted buns with mayo and pickles.

recipes.name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Sandwiches
directions: Season and grill or pan-sear the chicken; slice.
Toast rolls and spread with ranch.
Layer chicken, cheese and bacon; broil briefly to melt.
Add lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Pitas
directions: Marinate chicken in lemon juice, oregano, garlic and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or sear until cooked; slice.
Warm pitas and fill with chicken, cucumber, tomato and onion.
Spoon on tzatziki.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 450°F. Stretch dough on an oiled pan.
Spread with ranch; toss chicken in wing sauce and scatter over.
Top with mozzarella and blue cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes; sprinkle with green onions.

recipes.name: Chicken Cordon Bleu Pasta
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and boil the penne.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk; simmer until thick and stir in Swiss and mustard.
Mix sauce with pasta, chicken and ham; spread in a baking dish.
Top with panko and bake 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Baked Mac and Cheese
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and cook macaroni 2 minutes short of done.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk; simmer until thick.
Off the heat stir in mustard and most of the cheese.
Mix with the pasta, top with remaining cheese and panko, and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Sausage Manicotti
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and boil shells until just tender.
Brown sausage and drain; mix with ricotta, egg, half the mozzarella and parmesan.
Spread some sauce in a 9x13, fill the shells and lay them in.
Cover with remaining sauce and cheese; bake covered 30 minutes, uncovered 10.

recipes.name: One-Skillet Lasagna
directions: Brown beef in a deep skillet; drain.
Add marinara, water, seasoning and broken noodles; cover and simmer 15–18 minutes, stirring, until tender.
Dollop ricotta over the top and scatter mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Creamy Spinach Rigatoni Bake
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and cook rigatoni.
Melt cream cheese with milk and garlic; stir in spinach and parmesan.
Toss pasta with the cream sauce and marinara; spread in a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and bake 20 minutes.

ingredients.raw: 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed

recipes.name: Tortellini Carbonara
directions: Cook tortellini, adding peas for the last minute; drain.
Cook bacon until crisp; pour off most of the fat.
Add garlic, then cream; simmer 3 minutes and stir in parmesan.
Toss tortellini and peas in the sauce.

recipes.name: Ham and Swiss Baked Penne
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and cook penne.
Make a sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk; simmer until thick and stir in the Swiss.
Mix with pasta, ham and peas; spread in a baking dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and bake 20–25 minutes.

recipes.name: Creamy Pasta Primavera
directions: Cook penne, adding broccoli for the last 2 minutes.
Sauté zucchini, pepper and garlic in oil until crisp-tender; add tomatoes.
Pour in half-and-half and parmesan and simmer 2 minutes.
Toss with pasta and broccoli.

recipes.name: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and cook spaghetti.
Cook mushrooms in butter, stir in flour, then broth and milk; simmer until thick.
Stir in half the parmesan, chicken, peas and spaghetti; spread in a 9x13.
Top with remaining parmesan and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Rigatoni with Sausage and Peas
directions: Cook rigatoni.
Brown sausage, breaking it up; add garlic for a minute.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; stir in cream and peas.
Toss with pasta and parmesan.

recipes.name: Gnocchi Alfredo
directions: Boil gnocchi until they float; drain.
Melt butter and cook garlic 1 minute; add cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and nutmeg, then spinach until wilted.
Toss in the gnocchi.

recipes.name: Chicken Gnocchi Skillet
directions: Brown gnocchi in oil until golden; remove.
Cook chicken with garlic until done.
Add tomatoes and broth; simmer 3 minutes.
Return gnocchi, stir in spinach and parmesan.

recipes.name: Sausage Bow Tie Pasta
directions: Cook pasta.
Brown sausage with onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and cream; simmer until slightly thick, about 6 minutes.
Toss with pasta, parmesan and basil.

recipes.name: Vegetable Lasagna
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and boil the noodles.
Sauté zucchini, mushrooms and pepper until tender.
Mix ricotta, egg and spinach.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta, vegetables and mozzarella three times.
Bake covered 30 minutes, uncovered 15; rest 10 minutes.

ingredients.raw: 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed

recipes.name: Broccoli Mac and Cheese Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Cook macaroni, adding broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Make a cheese sauce: butter, flour, then milk; simmer and stir in 2 cups cheese.
Combine and spread in a baking dish.
Top with remaining cheese and panko; bake 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
directions: Cook penne.
Toss chicken in cajun seasoning and sear until cooked; set aside.
Cook peppers and garlic until tender; add cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan, chicken and pasta.

recipes.name: Three-Cheese Stuffed Shells
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and boil shells until just tender.
Mix ricotta, half the mozzarella, parmesan, egg and spinach.
Spread half the sauce in a 9x13; fill shells and arrange.
Top with remaining sauce and mozzarella; bake covered 30 minutes.

ingredients.raw: 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Pasta
directions: Slow-cook chicken with wing sauce and broth on low 5 hours; shred.
Stir in cream cheese and ranch until smooth.
Cook pasta and stir it in with the mozzarella.

recipes.name: One-Pot Enchilada Pasta
directions: Put pasta, enchilada sauce, tomatoes and broth in a pot; bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered, stirring, 12 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in beans, corn and cheese until melted.
Top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Lasagna Cups
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Brown beef, drain, and stir in marinara.
Press a wonton into each cup; add ricotta, sauce and mozzarella. Repeat with a second layer.
Sprinkle parmesan and bake 15–18 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: One-Pan Tuscan Ravioli
directions: Simmer tomatoes, beans, broth and garlic 5 minutes.
Add ravioli and kale; cover and cook 6–8 minutes until tender.
Top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan Stuffed Shells
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and boil shells.
Mix chicken, ricotta, half the mozzarella and parmesan.
Fill shells and set on sauce in a 9x13; spoon more sauce over.
Top with mozzarella and panko; bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: BBQ Pork and Penne Skillet
directions: Cook penne and drain.
Warm pork with bbq sauce in the same pot.
Add pasta, milk and cheese; stir until creamy.
Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Stuffed Pork Chops
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Cut a pocket in each chop.
Soften onion and celery in butter, add broth and sage, then stir in stuffing mix.
Fill the chops, sear on both sides, then bake 30–35 minutes until 145°F.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Pork Supper
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes and carrots with oil, thyme and salt; roast 15 minutes.
Mix mustard and honey and brush over the pork.
Add pork to the pan and roast 20–25 minutes until 145°F.
Rest 5 minutes and slice.

recipes.name: Pork Chops and Asparagus
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Roast potatoes with half the oil 15 minutes.
Season chops with garlic, paprika and salt; add to the pan with asparagus tossed in the rest of the oil.
Roast 15 minutes until the pork reaches 145°F.
Sprinkle asparagus with parmesan.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Pepper Sandwiches
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Toss peppers and onion with oil and seasoning on a sheet pan.
Add sausages and roast 25–30 minutes, turning once.
Fill rolls with sausage, peppers and provolone; broil 1–2 minutes to melt.

recipes.name: Pepperoni Calzones
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Divide dough into 4 and roll into circles.
Fill half of each with ricotta, mozzarella, pepperoni and seasoning.
Fold, pinch shut, brush with beaten egg and cut a small slit.
Bake 15 minutes until golden; serve with warm marinara.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Mustard Noodles
directions: Cook egg noodles.
Season chops and brown in butter until 145°F; set aside.
Add broth to the pan and simmer, scraping up the brown bits; whisk in sour cream and mustard.
Toss noodles in the sauce and serve with the chops.

recipes.name: Cider-Glazed Pork Tenderloin
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Season pork with thyme, salt and pepper and sear in butter on all sides.
Roast 15–20 minutes until 145°F; rest.
Meanwhile boil cider, brown sugar and mustard in the pan until syrupy.
Slice the pork and spoon the glaze over.

recipes.name: Barbecue Pork Chops
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown chops in oil and set in a baking dish.
Scatter onion over them.
Mix bbq sauce and brown sugar and pour over.
Bake covered 30 minutes, uncovered 10, until 145°F.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Pork and Orzo
directions: Season pork with oregano and brown in oil; set aside.
Add orzo and broth to the pan; simmer covered 10 minutes.
Stir in pork, spinach and tomatoes and cook until the orzo is tender.
Top with feta.

recipes.name: Pork Marsala
directions: Flatten medallions, dust with flour and brown in butter; set aside.
Cook mushrooms in the pan until golden.
Add marsala and broth and simmer until reduced by half; stir in cream.
Return pork to heat through. Serve with linguine.

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, sliced into medallions

recipes.name: Pork Ramen Stir-Fry
directions: Cook ramen noodles (discard seasoning packets) and drain.
Stir-fry pork in sesame oil until browned.
Add broccoli, carrot and garlic; cook 3 minutes.
Toss in noodles, soy and hoisin.

recipes.name: Parmesan Pork Cutlets
directions: Set out flour, beaten egg, and panko mixed with parmesan.
Coat cutlets in each.
Fry in oil 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked.
Serve with lemon wedges and a salad.

recipes.name: Bacon-Swiss Pork Chops
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; remove and cook onion in the drippings until golden.
Season chops with garlic powder and cook in the pan until 145°F.
Top with onion, bacon and Swiss; cover until melted.

recipes.name: Quick Tacos al Pastor
directions: Toss pork with chipotles, cumin and salt.
Sear pork in a hot skillet until caramelized; add pineapple and cook 2 minutes.
Squeeze in lime.
Serve in warm tortillas with onion and cilantro.

recipes.name: Cheesy Ham Chowder
directions: Simmer potatoes, onion and carrots in broth 15 minutes until tender.
In a saucepan melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk until thick; stir in cheese.
Add the cheese sauce, ham and corn to the soup and heat through.

recipes.name: Navy Bean Soup
directions: Drain beans and put everything in a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 1 1/2 to 2 hours until the beans are soft.
Pull meat from the bone, return it to the pot and discard the bay leaf.
Mash some beans against the pot to thicken.

ingredients.raw: 1 lb dried navy beans, soaked overnight

ingredients.item: meaty ham bone or 2 cups diced ham
ingredients.raw: 1 meaty ham bone or 2 cups diced ham

recipes.name: Ham and Swiss Sliders
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Split the slab of rolls and set the bottoms in a baking dish.
Layer ham and Swiss, then add the tops.
Mix butter, mustard, worcestershire and poppy seeds; pour over.
Cover and bake 15 minutes, uncover and bake 5 more.

recipes.name: Pasta e Fagioli
directions: Brown sausage; add onion, carrots, celery and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, beans and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Add pasta and cook 8–10 minutes until tender.
Stir in spinach and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Dill Sauce
directions: Mix yogurt, dill, cucumber, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Season salmon and sear skin-side up in oil 4 minutes; flip and cook 3–4 more.
Steam the green beans.
Serve salmon with the dill sauce and beans.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Cook pasta.
Melt butter and cook garlic and pepper flakes 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, 2–3 minutes; add broth and lemon juice.
Toss with pasta, parsley and parmesan.

recipes.name: Orange Soy Salmon with Rice
directions: Mix orange juice, soy, honey and ginger; marinate salmon 15 minutes.
Heat oven to 400°F and bake salmon 12–15 minutes.
Simmer the leftover marinade until syrupy.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli; drizzle with sauce and green onions.

recipes.name: Baked Crab Cakes
directions: Heat oven to 400°F and line a pan with parchment.
Gently mix everything except the lemon; shape into 8 cakes.
Bake 15 minutes until golden, flipping halfway.
Serve with lemon wedges and a salad or slaw.

recipes.name: Cornmeal-Crusted Catfish
directions: Dip fillets in buttermilk.
Coat in cornmeal mixed with flour and cajun seasoning.
Fry in oil 3–4 minutes per side until golden and flaky.
Serve with lemon, coleslaw and hush puppies or fries.

recipes.name: Tilapia Florentine
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Wilt spinach in oil and let cool.
Mix spinach with ricotta, egg and parmesan.
Set tilapia in a baking dish, squeeze lemon over and spread the spinach mixture on top.
Bake 15–20 minutes until the fish flakes.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Soy-Ginger Salmon
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix soy, honey, ginger and garlic.
Toss vegetables with sesame oil on a sheet pan and roast 10 minutes.
Add salmon, brush with the sauce, and roast 12 more minutes.

recipes.name: Parmesan Fish Sticks
directions: Heat oven to 425°F and grease a rack set on a baking sheet.
Dip fish in beaten egg, then in panko mixed with parmesan and paprika.
Bake 12–15 minutes until golden.
Serve with tartar sauce.

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb cod fillets, cut in strips

recipes.name: Lemon Baked Cod
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Boil potatoes until tender.
Set cod in a baking dish; mix butter, garlic and lemon juice and pour over.
Sprinkle with panko and bake 12–15 minutes.
Top with parsley and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chipotle Lime Shrimp
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Roast potatoes and corn with half the oil for 25 minutes.
Toss shrimp with remaining oil, chipotle, lime zest and salt.
Add shrimp to the pan and roast 8 minutes until pink.
Squeeze lime over and top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Tilapia with Corn Salsa
directions: Mix corn, beans, tomato, onion, lime juice and salt for the salsa.
Season tilapia with chili powder and salt.
Cook in oil 3 minutes per side until flaky.
Spoon salsa over the fish.

recipes.name: Shrimp Po'Boys
directions: Toss slaw mix and pineapple with half the mayo.
Coat shrimp in cornmeal and cajun seasoning; pan-fry in oil until crisp.
Mix remaining mayo with hot sauce and spread on toasted rolls.
Fill with shrimp and slaw.

recipes.name: Shrimp Marinara
directions: Cook spaghetti.
Cook garlic and pepper flakes in oil 1 minute; add marinara and simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink.
Toss with spaghetti and basil.

recipes.name: Garlic Lemon Shrimp
directions: Cook rice and steam or roast the asparagus.
Cook shrimp in oil 2 minutes, add garlic and cook until pink.
Add lemon juice and zest and parsley.
Serve over rice with asparagus.

recipes.name: Shrimp Creole
directions: Soften onion, pepper, celery and garlic in a large skillet.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and cajun seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook 4 minutes until pink.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Broccoli Alfredo
directions: Cook fettuccine, adding broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Cook shrimp in butter with garlic until pink; remove.
Add cream to the pan, simmer 3 minutes and stir in parmesan.
Toss with pasta, broccoli and shrimp.

recipes.name: Sweet Chili Shrimp and Veggies
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Roast vegetables with oil 10 minutes.
Mix sweet chili sauce and soy; toss with shrimp.
Add shrimp to the pan and roast 6–8 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Shrimp Quesadillas
directions: Cook shrimp and pepper with chili powder until the shrimp are pink; chop.
Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and shrimp; fold.
Cook in a dry skillet until crisp and melted, about 2 minutes per side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Rosemary Salmon and Veggies
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Roast potatoes with half the oil 15 minutes.
Add asparagus, pepper and salmon; drizzle with remaining oil and sprinkle rosemary and salt.
Roast 12–15 minutes and finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Sausage Foil Packets
directions: Heat grill or oven to 400°F.
Divide shrimp, sausage, corn and potatoes among 4 sheets of foil.
Drizzle with butter, sprinkle with cajun seasoning and seal.
Cook 15–18 minutes; open carefully and squeeze lemon over.

ingredients.raw: 1 lb baby red potatoes, quartered and par-boiled

recipes.name: New England Clam Chowder
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; soften onion and celery in the drippings.
Stir in flour, then clam juice, the juice from the cans and potatoes; simmer 15 minutes.
Add clams and half-and-half and heat without boiling.
Season and serve with oyster crackers.

recipes.name: Tuna Melts
directions: Mix tuna, mayo, celery and pickles.
Spread on bread, top with cheddar and close the sandwiches.
Butter the outsides and grill in a skillet until golden and melted.

recipes.name: Cajun Shrimp Skillet
directions: Brown sausage in oil.
Add onion, pepper and zucchini; cook 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and cajun seasoning; cook until pink.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Spicy Shrimp Penne
directions: Cook penne.
Cook garlic and pepper flakes in oil, then add tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink; stir in spinach.
Toss with pasta and parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy Salmon Linguine
directions: Cook linguine, adding peas for the last minute.
Cook salmon in butter until just done; set aside.
Add garlic, cream and lemon zest to the pan and simmer 3 minutes; stir in parmesan.
Toss with pasta, then gently fold in the salmon.

ingredients.raw: 1 lb salmon fillet, skin removed, cubed

recipes.name: Tomato Soup
directions: Melt butter and cook onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes, broth and sugar; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in cream and basil.
Serve with grilled cheese.

recipes.name: Bacon Potato Corn Chowder
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; remove and soften onion in the drippings.
Stir in flour, then broth and potatoes; simmer 15 minutes.
Add corn and milk and heat through.
Top with bacon and cheddar.

recipes.name: Hearty Vegetable Soup
directions: Soften onion, carrots and celery in a large pot.
Add potatoes, green beans, tomatoes, broth and seasoning; simmer 25 minutes.
Add corn for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Lentil Tomato Soup
directions: Soften onion, carrots and garlic.
Add lentils, tomatoes, broth and cumin; simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted.

recipes.name: Butternut Squash Soup
directions: Melt butter and soften onion and carrots.
Add squash, apple and broth; simmer 25 minutes until soft.
Blend smooth and stir in cream and nutmeg.
Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Beef Barley Soup
directions: Brown beef with onion; drain.
Add carrots, celery, barley, lentils, tomatoes and broth.
Simmer covered 45 minutes until the barley and lentils are tender.

recipes.name: Hearty Vegetarian Chili
directions: Soften onion, pepper and garlic.
Stir in chili powder and cumin for a minute.
Add beans, tomatoes and corn with 1 cup water; simmer 25 minutes.
Top with cheese, sour cream and green onions.

recipes.name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Soften onion and garlic; stir in cumin and cinnamon.
Add sweet potato, chickpeas, tomatoes and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach.
Serve over couscous.

recipes.name: Loaded Mexican Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 425°F.
Spread crust with refried beans mixed with salsa.
Top with cheese, tomato and olives; bake 10–12 minutes.
Finish with lettuce and green onions.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Skillet Enchiladas
directions: Simmer beans, corn and enchilada sauce in a skillet 3 minutes.
Stir in tortilla strips and half the cheese.
Top with remaining cheese, cover and cook until melted.
Serve with avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Bean and Rice Burritos
directions: Warm beans, refried beans, rice, salsa and cumin together.
Fill tortillas with the mixture and cheese; roll up.
Toast seam-side down in a skillet until golden.

recipes.name: Black Bean Burgers
directions: Mash beans, then mix in rice, breadcrumbs, egg, salsa and cumin.
Shape into 4 patties and chill 15 minutes.
Cook in an oiled skillet 4–5 minutes per side; add cheese at the end.
Serve on buns with avocado.

recipes.name: Spinach Pizza Quesadillas
directions: Top 4 tortillas with mozzarella, spinach, tomato and seasoning; cover with the rest.
Cook in a skillet until golden on both sides and melted.
Cut into wedges and dip in warm pizza sauce.

recipes.name: Easy Chana Masala
directions: Soften onion, garlic and ginger in oil.
Stir in garam masala and cumin for a minute.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer 15 minutes, then stir in coconut milk.
Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Black Bean Sweet Potato Bowls
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Roast sweet potatoes with oil and chili powder 25 minutes.
Cook rice and warm the beans.
Build bowls with rice, beans and sweet potatoes.
Top with avocado, salsa and lime.

recipes.name: Garden Vegetable Gnocchi
directions: Heat oven to 450°F. Toss gnocchi and vegetables with oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 minutes, stirring once, until the gnocchi are golden.
Toss with pesto and parmesan.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Pad Thai
directions: Soak noodles in hot water until soft; drain.
Brown tofu in oil; push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, soy, brown sugar and lime juice; toss until coated.
Add bean sprouts and green onions; top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Falafel Pitas
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley and cumin in a food processor until coarse; mix in flour.
Shape into small patties.
Pan-fry in oil 3 minutes per side until crisp (or bake at 400°F for 20 minutes).
Stuff into pitas with cucumber and tzatziki.

recipes.name: Cheese Tortellini with Tomatoes and Corn
directions: Cook tortellini, adding corn for the last 2 minutes; drain.
Warm garlic in oil, then add tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Toss with tortellini, corn, basil and parmesan.

recipes.name: Veggie Tacos
directions: Sauté zucchini and pepper until tender.
Add corn, beans and spices; cook until hot.
Fill warm tortillas and top with queso fresco and avocado.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
directions: Spread butter on one side of each slice and a thin layer of mayo over the butter.
Build sandwiches with the cheese inside, buttered sides out.
Cook over medium-low heat until deep golden and melted, 3–4 minutes per side. Great with tomato soup.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown sausage and drain.
Whisk eggs, milk and chiles.
Layer tortillas, sausage, cheese and egg mixture in a 9x13, twice.
Bake 40–45 minutes until set; serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Breakfast Enchiladas
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown sausage, then scramble 10 eggs into it.
Fill tortillas with the eggs and some cheese; roll and place in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over and top with remaining cheese.
Bake 20 minutes; sprinkle with green onions.

recipes.name: Crescent Roll Breakfast Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Press crescent dough into a greased pan, sealing the seams.
Brown sausage and sprinkle over the dough with the hash browns and cheese.
Whisk eggs and milk and pour over.
Bake 25–30 minutes until the eggs are set.

ingredients.raw: 2 cups frozen shredded hash browns, thawed

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
directions: Warm beans and salsa in separate pans.
Crisp tortillas in a lightly oiled skillet.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Top tortillas with beans, eggs, salsa, avocado, queso fresco and cilantro.

recipes.name: Crustless Spinach Quiche
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and grease a pie plate.
Soften onion in a little butter.
Whisk eggs, milk and nutmeg; stir in spinach, onion and cheese.
Pour into the dish and bake 35–40 minutes until set.

ingredients.raw: 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed

recipes.name: BLT Egg Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Spread bread cubes in a greased baking dish with bacon and cheese.
Whisk eggs and milk and pour over; let soak 10 minutes.
Top with tomato slices and bake 40 minutes.
Serve with lettuce on the side or on top.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
directions: Soften onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil; stir in spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook 6–8 minutes until whites are set.
Top with feta and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Reuben Sandwiches
directions: Spread dressing on the bread.
Layer corned beef, sauerkraut and Swiss.
Butter the outsides and grill in a skillet until crisp and melted.

recipes.name: Monte Cristo Sandwiches
directions: Build sandwiches with ham, turkey and Swiss.
Whisk eggs and milk; dip each sandwich on both sides.
Cook in butter over medium heat until golden and melted.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with jam.

ingredients.item: powdered sugar and raspberry jam for serving
ingredients.raw: powdered sugar and raspberry jam for serving

recipes.name: Chicken Melts
directions: Heat the broiler. Mix chicken, mayo, celery and mustard.
Toast English muffins.
Top each half with chicken salad, tomato and cheese.
Broil 2–3 minutes until melted.

recipes.name: Pulled Brisket Sandwiches
directions: Rub brisket with chili powder, brown sugar and salt.
Put onion in the slow cooker, add brisket, bbq sauce and broth.
Cook on low 9–10 hours, then shred in the sauce.
Serve on buns with pickles.

recipes.name: Beef Gyros
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Mix beef, onion, garlic, oregano, cumin and salt.
Press into a thin rectangle on a parchment-lined pan and bake 20–25 minutes.
Slice into strips.
Fill warm pitas with meat, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Breadstick Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Unroll breadstick dough into a greased sheet pan, pressing seams together.
Bake 6 minutes.
Spread sauce, then top with cheese, pepperoni and pepper.
Bake 12–15 more minutes; cut into strips.

recipes.name: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Stir chicken, cream cheese, chiles and half the salsa together over low heat.
Fill tortillas, roll and set in a 9x13.
Mix enchilada sauce with remaining salsa and pour over.
Top with cheese and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken and Dumplings
directions: Simmer carrots, celery and onion in broth 10 minutes.
Add chicken and peas.
Stir baking mix and milk into a soft dough; drop spoonfuls onto the simmering soup.
Cover and cook 15 minutes without lifting the lid.

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
directions: Melt butter and soften onion; stir in flour.
Whisk in broth and milk; add broccoli and carrots.
Simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in cheese a handful at a time until melted.

recipes.name: Minestrone
directions: Soften onion, carrots, celery and garlic in olive oil.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, beans and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Stir in spinach and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 375°F and cook noodles.
Mix soup, sour cream, tuna, peas and half the cheese; fold in noodles.
Spread in a baking dish and top with remaining cheese and panko.
Bake 20–25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Season and grill or pan-sear the chicken; slice.
Toss romaine with dressing and a squeeze of lemon.
Top with chicken, parmesan and croutons.

recipes.name: Barbecued Chicken
directions: Simmer ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar, worcestershire and spices 5 minutes for the sauce.
Season chicken and grill over medium heat, turning, 30–35 minutes.
Brush with sauce for the last 10 minutes until 175°F. (Or bake at 400°F for 40 minutes.)

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Fajitas
directions: Heat oven to 400°F.
Toss chicken, peppers and onion with oil and seasoning on a sheet pan.
Bake 20–25 minutes until the chicken is done.
Serve in warm tortillas with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Steam broccoli 3 minutes and spread in a baking dish with the chicken.
Mix soup, mayo, lemon juice and cheese; spread over.
Toss crackers with butter and sprinkle on top.
Bake 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Biscuit Pot Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Mix chicken, vegetables, soup, milk and thyme in a deep baking dish.
Bake 10 minutes until hot, then set biscuits on top.
Bake 15 minutes more until the biscuits are golden.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
directions: Season fish with chili powder, cumin and salt; sear in oil 3 minutes per side and flake.
Whisk sour cream, mayo and lime juice for the sauce.
Warm tortillas.
Fill with fish, cabbage and avocado; drizzle with sauce.

recipes.name: Grilled Barbecued Salmon
directions: Rub salmon with brown sugar, paprika and salt.
Grill corn over medium-high 10 minutes, turning.
Grill salmon skin-side down 6–8 minutes, brushing with bbq sauce, until it flakes.
Serve with lemon and the corn.

recipes.name: Sweet and Tangy Salmon with Green Beans
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss green beans with oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Set salmon in the middle.
Mix brown sugar, soy, mustard and butter; brush over the salmon.
Roast 14–16 minutes.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
directions: Cook shrimp in a little oil until pink; set aside.
Scramble eggs in the pan; set aside.
Stir-fry rice and vegetables in remaining oil until hot.
Add soy, sesame oil, shrimp, eggs and green onions; toss.

recipes.name: Salmon Stir-Fry
directions: Stir-fry vegetables in oil 3–4 minutes; push aside.
Add salmon and cook gently 3 minutes.
Mix soy, honey and ginger; pour in and toss carefully.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
directions: Soften onion, carrots and celery in butter; stir in flour.
Whisk in broth, add rice and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in chicken and milk and heat through.

recipes.name: Mexican Chicken Corn Chowder
directions: Brown chicken with onion and garlic.
Add broth, corn, chiles and cumin; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in half-and-half and cheese until melted.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Honey Mustard Chicken
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with oil and salt; roast 10 minutes.
Whisk honey, mustard and garlic powder; coat the chicken.
Add chicken and green beans to the pan; roast 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Smoked Sausage and Veggie Sheet-Pan Supper
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Roast potatoes with half the oil 15 minutes.
Add sausage, broccoli, pepper and onion with remaining oil and seasoning.
Roast 20 minutes more.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Curry
directions: Heat oven to 425°F.
Toss chicken and vegetables with oil, curry powder and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 30–35 minutes.
Serve over rice with a spoonful of yogurt.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Tilapia
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Set tilapia on a sheet pan; season with oregano, salt and lemon zest.
Scatter tomatoes, olives and artichokes around and drizzle with oil.
Bake 12–15 minutes; top with feta and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Lemon-Dijon Pork Sheet-Pan Supper
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Roast sweet potatoes and Brussels sprouts with 2 tablespoons oil for 15 minutes.
Mix mustard, lemon juice, garlic and remaining oil; brush over the chops.
Add chops to the pan and roast 15 minutes until 145°F.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Tamale Pie
directions: Brown beef with onion; stir in seasoning, beans, tomatoes and corn and put in the slow cooker.
Mix cornbread batter with egg and milk; spread over the top.
Cook on low 4 hours until the cornbread is set.
Sprinkle with cheese for the last 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Spaghetti and Meatballs
directions: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and seasoning; roll into 1 1/2-inch meatballs.
Pour 1 jar sauce in the slow cooker, add meatballs, then the second jar.
Cook on low 6 hours.
Serve over cooked spaghetti.

recipes.name: Beef and Shells
directions: Cook shells.
Brown beef with onion; drain.
Add tomato sauce, tomatoes and seasoning; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in shells and top with cheese.

recipes.name: Beef Noodle Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and cook noodles.
Brown beef with onion; stir in tomato sauce.
Mix cream cheese and sour cream with the noodles.
Layer noodles and beef in a baking dish, top with cheese and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Beef Fajitas
directions: Put onion and peppers in the slow cooker with the beef on top.
Sprinkle with seasoning and add salsa.
Cook on low 6–7 hours; squeeze in lime.
Serve in warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Salsa Roast
directions: Rub roast with taco seasoning and set in the slow cooker.
Pour salsa over and cook on low 8 hours.
Shred, stir in beans and heat 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or in tortillas.

recipes.name: Chunky Beef Chili
directions: Brown beef in batches.
Put everything in the slow cooker and stir.
Cook on low 8 hours.
Top with cheese and sour cream.

ingredients.raw: 2 lb beef stew meat, cut small

recipes.name: Taco Skillet
directions: Brown beef and drain; stir in seasoning.
Add beans, tomatoes, rice and broth; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Top with cheese and cover until melted.

recipes.name: Cheddar Bean Burritos
directions: Soften onion, add beans, spices and salsa, and mash roughly as it heats.
Spread on tortillas, top with cheese and roll up.
Toast seam-side down until golden; serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Black Bean Chimichangas
directions: Heat oven to 425°F. Mash half the beans and mix with the rest, rice, salsa and cumin.
Fill tortillas with beans and cheese and fold into packets.
Brush with butter and bake seam-side down 15 minutes until crisp.

recipes.name: Skillet Pork Chop Dinner
directions: Brown chops in oil; set aside.
Add potatoes, carrots and onion to the pan.
Whisk soup and broth, pour over and set the chops on top.
Cover and simmer 30–35 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Apple Pork Chops
directions: Season chops and brown in 1 tablespoon butter until 145°F; set aside.
Add remaining butter, apples, brown sugar and spices; cook until the apples are tender.
Spoon apples over the chops.

recipes.name: Sage Pork Chops with Cider Gravy
directions: Season chops with sage, salt and pepper; brown in butter until 145°F.
Remove chops, stir flour into the pan drippings.
Whisk in cider and broth and simmer until thick.
Pour gravy over the chops. Good with mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Greek Chicken
directions: Put potatoes and onion in the slow cooker.
Season chicken with oregano, garlic, lemon zest and salt; set on top.
Add broth and lemon juice and cook on low 6 hours.
Top with feta.

recipes.name: Pineapple Chicken
directions: Brown chicken with garlic.
Add pepper and pineapple chunks; cook 3 minutes.
Whisk pineapple juice, soy, brown sugar and cornstarch; pour in and simmer until thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteaks
directions: Cook onion and pepper in oil until soft; push aside.
Add steak and cook quickly, chopping, until just done.
Mix with the vegetables, top with provolone and let it melt.
Scoop into toasted rolls.

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb ribeye steak, very thinly sliced

recipes.name: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown beef with onion and pepper; drain.
Stir in ketchup, brown sugar, mustard and worcestershire.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon onto buns.

recipes.name: Meatball Subs
directions: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg and parmesan; roll into 18 meatballs.
Brown meatballs, add marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Fill rolls with meatballs and sauce, top with provolone.
Broil 2 minutes until melted.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Slow-cook chicken with half the wing sauce and the broth on low 6 hours.
Shred and stir in remaining sauce and butter.
Toss slaw with ranch.
Pile chicken and slaw on buns.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan Sandwiches
directions: Dip chicken in egg, then panko mixed with parmesan.
Fry in oil 3–4 minutes per side until cooked.
Top with marinara and mozzarella; cover until melted.
Serve on toasted rolls.

ingredients.raw: 2 chicken breasts, halved and pounded thin

recipes.name: Peanut Ginger Noodles
directions: Cook spaghetti; save 1/2 cup water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, honey, vinegar and ginger, thinning with pasta water.
Toss with pasta, pepper and cucumber.
Top with green onions. Good warm or cold.

recipes.name: Quinoa Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
directions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Mix quinoa, beans, salsa, corn, cumin and half the cheese.
Fill peppers and set in a baking dish with a splash of water; cover with foil.
Bake 30 minutes, top with remaining cheese and bake 5 more.

recipes.name: Chicken Broccoli Shells
directions: Cook shells, adding broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Warm alfredo sauce with milk.
Toss with pasta, broccoli and chicken.
Top with both cheeses; broil 2 minutes if you like.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Cook spaghetti and toss with eggs and parmesan; press into a greased pie plate.
Spread ricotta over the crust.
Brown beef, add marinara and spoon on top.
Cover with mozzarella and bake 25 minutes; rest 5 before slicing.

recipes.name: Four-Cheese Chicken Fettuccine
directions: Cook fettuccine.
Warm cream with garlic and cream cheese until smooth.
Stir in the other cheeses until melted, then the chicken.
Toss with pasta.

recipes.name: Italian Pasta Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and cook ziti.
Brown sausage with onion and pepper; drain and add marinara.
Mix with pasta and pepperoni; spread in a 9x13.
Top with mozzarella and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Meatball Stroganoff
directions: Cook noodles.
Soften onion and mushrooms; stir in flour, then broth.
Add meatballs and simmer 15 minutes until hot.
Stir in sour cream off the heat and serve over noodles.

recipes.name: Pizza Mac and Cheese
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Make the macaroni and cheese as the box says.
Spread in a baking dish and cover with pizza sauce.
Top with mozzarella, pepperoni and seasoning.
Bake 20 minutes.

ingredients.raw: 1 box macaroni and cheese dinner (14 oz)

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 425°F.
Spread crust with half the dressing; top with chicken and mozzarella.
Bake 10–12 minutes.
Toss romaine with remaining dressing and parmesan and pile on top.

recipes.name: Easy Stuffed Poblanos
directions: Heat oven to 400°F. Roast poblano halves on a sheet pan 10 minutes.
Brown chorizo; mix with rice, salsa and half the cheese.
Fill peppers, top with remaining cheese and bake 15 minutes.
Serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Meatloaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Mix beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, onion and half the tomato sauce; shape a loaf in a baking dish.
Mix remaining tomato sauce with brown sugar, vinegar and mustard.
Spoon half over the loaf and bake 1 hour, adding the rest for the last 15 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Hamburger Rice Hot Dish
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown beef with onion and celery; drain.
Stir in uncooked rice, both soups and broth.
Pour into a baking dish, cover and bake 1 hour, stirring once, until the rice is tender.

recipes.name: Chili Tortilla Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brown beef; stir in beans, tomatoes, corn and chili powder.
Layer tortillas, beef and cheese in a baking dish; repeat.
Bake 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Spanish Noodles with Ground Beef
directions: Brown beef with onion and pepper; drain.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth and paprika; bring to a boil.
Stir in uncooked noodles, cover and simmer 10–12 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender.

recipes.name: Ground Beef Tacos
directions: Brown beef, drain, and stir in seasoning with 2/3 cup water; simmer 5 minutes.
Warm taco shells in the oven.
Fill with beef and top with cheese, lettuce, tomato, sour cream and salsa.
